IVX HOLDINGS — ENABLE AUTOMATED IOS QA
DO NOT MARK IOS BLOCKED ONLY BECAUSE THE CURRENT SANDBOX HAS NO IPHONE

Rork must move iOS QA to an environment that supports iOS testing.

Use this order:

1. EAS Workflows + Maestro
2. BrowserStack real iPhone cloud
3. Mac runner + Xcode Simulator

Physical owner testing remains the final confirmation, not the only possible test.

==================================================
OPTION A — EAS WORKFLOWS + MAESTRO
==================================================

Implement an EAS iOS simulator build profile.

Required eas.json profile:

- iOS simulator enabled
- development or QA build
- correct IVX bundle identifier
- correct production or isolated QA API environment
- no server secrets in client
- commit SHA embedded in build metadata

Create Maestro flows for:

1. Launch app
2. Owner login
3. Open IVX Chat
4. Confirm latest conversation opens
5. Confirm newest message is visible
6. Confirm yellow arrow is hidden on initial open
7. Send a message
8. Confirm message appears once
9. Receive or simulate authorized realtime reply
10. Scroll to older messages
11. Trigger pagination
12. Confirm visible position remains stable
13. Return to latest
14. Open keyboard
15. Enter multiline text
16. Close keyboard
17. Background and resume
18. Restart app
19. Reopen chat
20. Confirm newest message remains visible

Capture:

- EAS workflow ID
- iOS build ID
- Simulator model
- iOS version
- Maestro test report
- JUnit results
- Screenshots
- Video
- Logs
- Commit SHA
- Trace IDs

Required:

IOS SIMULATOR BUILD: PASS
MAESTRO FLOWS: PASS
FAILED IOS FLOWS: 0

==================================================
OPTION B — BROWSERSTACK REAL IPHONE QA
==================================================

If simulator QA passes, upload the iOS QA build to BrowserStack.

Run on at least:

- One current iPhone model/current iOS
- One older supported iPhone/iOS
- One smaller-screen iPhone

Use Maestro, Appium, or XCUITest.

Test:

- Login
- Chat open
- Latest message
- No initial jump
- Message ordering
- Send/receive
- Pagination
- Keyboard
- Background/resume
- Restart
- Safe-area layout
- Network interruption
- Reconnect

Capture:

- BrowserStack session IDs
- Device models
- iOS versions
- Videos
- Screenshots
- Network logs
- Console/device logs
- Test results
- Commit SHA

Required:

REAL IPHONE CLOUD TESTS: PASS
CRASHES: 0
DUPLICATE MESSAGES: 0
VISIBLE INITIAL JUMP: false
LATEST MESSAGE IMMEDIATELY VISIBLE: true

==================================================
OPTION C — MAC + XCODE SIMULATOR
==================================================

If EAS Workflows is unavailable, use a Mac runner with Xcode.

Required:

- Install required Xcode/iOS simulator runtime
- Build the Expo iOS simulator app
- Install it in Simulator
- Run the same Maestro or XCUITest flows
- Capture screenshots, videos, logs, and results

Do not mark PASS from compilation alone.

==================================================
IOS QA ACCEPTANCE LEVELS
==================================================

Use these labels:

IOS CODE QA: PASS/FAIL
IOS SIMULATOR QA: PASS/FAIL
IOS REAL CLOUD DEVICE QA: PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN
IOS OWNER PHYSICAL DEVICE QA: PASS/FAIL/PENDING

A feature may be reported as:

PARTIAL — IOS SIMULATOR QA PASSED, OWNER PHYSICAL DEVICE QA PENDING

Do not report iOS as completely blocked unless all three testing paths are unavailable.

==================================================
FINAL REQUIRED RESPONSE
==================================================

Return:

IOS TESTING PLATFORM:
EAS WORKFLOW ID:
IOS BUILD ID:
SIMULATOR MODEL:
IOS VERSION:
MAESTRO RESULT:
BROWSERSTACK SESSION IDS:
REAL IPHONE RESULT:
SCREENSHOTS:
VIDEO:
LOGS:
TRACE IDS:
GITHUB COMMIT:
PRODUCTION COMMIT:
FAILED TESTS:
BLOCKED TESTS:
FINAL IOS VERDICT:

Allowed verdicts:

- VERIFIED — IOS AUTOMATED QA PASSED
- PARTIAL — SIMULATOR PASSED, REAL DEVICE PENDING
- BLOCKED — NO IOS TEST INFRASTRUCTURE AVAILABLE
- FAILED — IOS DEFECT FOUND
